checks.explanation: All 230 project tests and 139 subtests passed with credential and live-opt-in environment variables cleared. The profile suite validates Draft 2020-12 schema, endpoint-specific capability claims, evidence paths, environment variable names only, and rejection of inline key-like values.

findings: LLM-02 offline fail-closed behavior is supported by current tests.
LLM-06 unsupported capability preflight and global HTTP 400 no-fallback are supported, but all routes unavailable does not enter retry_wait and has no persistent recovery path.
LLM-01 real OpenAI web_search event and receipt correlation remains unverified because no live request was sent.
review.follow_up: Independent reviewer follow-up is complete. Raw pytest stdout and isolated execution metadata are bound in this receipt; implementation and live acceptance remain open.

rollback_evidence: No StockQA or other external repository files were written. Offline TEMP roots were removed. Three explicitly requested live provider probes used process-environment credentials without printing or persisting their values: Token Plan returned HTTP 400 with webSearchEnabled=false; two pay-as-you-go requests returned HTTP 200 and real search citations (the first response was truncated at the token cap, the second omitted the requested revenue figure). No local/external repository files were changed by those requests. MiniMax probes: api.minimax.cn returned text with no search receipt, api.minimax.io rejected the current key, and api.minimaxi.com completed one real web_search call. DeepSeek direct probes used chat/completions, responses, and Anthropic Messages; the Anthropic route reported two search calls despite max_uses=1. No provider probe printed or persisted a key value, and no StockQA files were modified.
open_issues: LLM-01 requires one live public-company quick scan with the opt-in flag and local credential; key must not be sent in chat, and actual web_search tool-call count/charges may vary.
LLM-06 all-route-exhaustion retry_wait state and persistent bounded recovery are missing and block Q02 completion.

Local contracts use run-level retry_wait in acceptance/deployment schema, waiting_for_provider in C05 prose, and no retry_wait value in the C04 WorkItem enum; status ownership and transient-vs-configuration recovery triggers must be reconciled before implementation.

MiMo Token Plan endpoint returned webSearchEnabled=false although the user confirms the plugin was enabled; root cause remains unresolved. Official Token Plan terms restrict package keys to programming tools and prohibit automated scripts/custom backends, so do not use MIMO_PLAN_API_KEY for company quick-scan requests.

Direct pay-as-you-go MiMo API search worked with a real source and one tool/page usage, but this is not StockQA CLI E2E; StockQA currently uses OpenAI Responses web_search and MiMo Chat Completions adaptation/receipt contract is not implemented or authorized.

MiniMax-M3 real direct web_search passed on api.minimaxi.com, but documented api.minimax.io rejected the current credential and api.minimax.cn text path had no search receipt; StockQA adapter E2E remains unverified.
DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible Messages API returned real server-side search results, but max_uses=1 did not limit observed usage to one search. StockQA adapter E2E remains unverified.
next_task: Reconcile run/dispatch retry_wait with C04 WorkItem and C05 waiting reason; finish provider-side LLM-06 semantics/tests within already authorized StockQA files, then seek any needed exact additional write scope for serialized/persistent recovery. Retry a permitted live end-to-end test only through a supported custom-application API route and record answer/source/search receipts.
